about: Grapes a wine region's English Wikipedia infobox lists (its «grapes» line), for registered names no register or article sentence gives varieties for, each name matched to a library grape by the grape's own names or a fixed alias; a name that is not one grape («Muscat», «Pinot») is left out. The line is kept as the quote. Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0. Built by scripts/kb/fetch-region-infobox-grapes.ts.
